summary: Verified 502 Bad Gateway is resolved. Frontend (Next.js) serves 200 on /, /privacy-policy, /purchase-pro-account. Language popup renders with English/Bangla + Continue; clicking Continue reveals home hero and USD/BRL chart card. Backend /api/ returns {message: Hello World}.

issues: USD/BRL chart area is empty — expected per agent note (NEXT_PUBLIC_QUOTEX_WS not configured); not a bug

critical_code_review_comments: package.json start script `test -f .next/BUILD_ID || next build; next start` works but is slow on cold start; consider prebuild in Dockerfile/CI to avoid first-request build latency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 502 root cause was missing .next/BUILD_ID; fixed via auto-build in yarn start. Only frontend verification requested; DB/WS-dependent features intentionally not tested.
rca of the issue: Next.js production `next start` requires prebuilt .next/BUILD_ID. Supervisor was launching `next start` without a prior `next build`, causing the app to exit and ingress returned 502. Fix in package.json start script now conditionally runs `next build` if BUILD_ID is missing, letting the service come up cleanly. All target routes return 200 with expected content.
